description: Regression: an escape sequence after the last newline (a colour reset, for example) was treated as a partial line. It was shown as an invisible prompt, and a submission before more server text committed it to scrollback as a blank line. Bytes with no printable text are not a prompt; they stay in the line assembler and begin the next server line.

scenarios.name: a colour reset after a newline is not committed as a blank line on submit

steps.note: E2E-HELLO CR LF, then ESC[0;39;49m with no text after it, in one server write
the submission has finished the partial line before its send
no blank row was committed for the escape-only bytes
the escape begins the next line's raw text, unmodified

scenarios.name: a GA prompt made only of escape sequences is not committed as a blank line

steps.note: E2E-GA CR LF, then ESC[0;39;49m IAC GA in one server write
